milestones.title: The first night
points: Eight guests, eight jobs, one curse: the core loop runs end to end with bots.
Day chores, the Vigil vote at dusk, the hunt at night.
The first full audio pass: rain, fire, footsteps through every room.

milestones.title: The house is repainted
points: Every floor, wall and object redrawn in the painted style.
Clocks with moving hands, candles that burn down overnight, curtains that stir.

milestones.title: Playtest 0.4
points: A Windows download with the new art, lighting, rain and snow.
Portraits whose eyes follow you; a rotary telephone you can dial.
The first trailer, with an original score.

milestones.title: Playtest 0.4.1
points: Online matches fixed for everyone in the house.
Before a match, everyone gathers in the Great Hall.

milestones.title: Playtest 0.5
points: Lay the dead to rest: drag bodies to the churchyard before the sin kills you.
A quieter screen that speaks in pictures, a real coal fire, a new title screen.
Sharper housemates who remember, catch lies and frame the innocent.
The game now updates itself from itch.
Online that works on every network, through a relay.
Close-ups at the Vigil, so you can read a liar's face.
Fog banks rolling over the lawn at night.
Portraits whose expressions change between days.
